title: benchmarks.py repro check proves on a probe instance that kbgit.py sync --push lands on its own bare copy and never on the real origin
goal: repro check builds a probe instance the same way, commits one _gaps.md entry there, runs kbgit.py sync --push in it and exits 0 only when the probe's bare main moved to that commit, the commit is not reachable from a fresh fetch of the real origin's main, the probe's mcp-config names the probe's kb_mcp.py and that script's --status prints the probe's kb_dir, the probe's query log mode is off and its claims ledger and _cache are its own, then removes the probe; no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle body of repro setup also runs repro check, with KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS=1 and a local bare standing in for the real origin.

clauses.clause: repro check builds a probe instance the same way, commits one _gaps.md entry there, runs kbgit.py sync --push in it and exits 0 only when the probe's bare main moved to that commit, the commit is not reachable from a fresh fetch of the real origin's main, the probe's mcp-config names the probe's kb_mcp.py and that script's --status prints the probe's kb_dir, the probe's query log mode is off and its claims ledger and _cache are its own, then removes the probe
no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle body of repro setup also runs repro check, with KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS=1 and a local bare standing in for the real origin

gates.question: Does the probe's kbgit.py sync --push run its test step, or does repro check always skip it?
options: run the probe's tests unless the caller has KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS set
always set KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS=1 for the probe
gates.recommendation: run the probe's tests unless the caller has KB_SYNC_NO_TESTS set

gates.question: Which topic does the probe's committed _gaps.md entry name, and where is the probe built?
options: the first article of the probe's clone, in a directory repro-check-PID of the scratch directory
a fixed topic name, in the default _cache/bench-repro directory
gates.recommendation: the first article of the probe's clone, in a directory repro-check-PID of the scratch directory
gates.answer: the first article of the probe's clone, in a directory repro-check-PID of the scratch directory

gates.question: What stands in for the real origin in the test bundle's repro check run, and how is its planted failure made?
options: the conftest kb_seed bare (this working tree's files; the clone's own history lacks blobs), with reaches patched to True for the planted failure
a bare clone of the checkout's HEAD
gates.recommendation: the conftest kb_seed bare (this working tree's files; the clone's own history lacks blobs), with reaches patched to True for the planted failure

notes: The test bundle passes before the work: it pins the new bodies once they are added; the repro subcommand checks fail before the work.
